name: C11_P7_SURVIVOR_RIGIDITY_GATE

source_binding.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring
frozen_source_facts: z is anticomplete to stored V(Q_TT')={p,m,n}
by symmetry orient so f'(m) belongs to L_{P'}(y), hence ym is a nonedge
choose s in T minus T'
z-y-s-p-m-n is an induced P6 in the published proof

scope: Static C11 survivor-rigidity theorem only. No repair, no new state, no enumeration, no matrix continuation.
orientation: Fix the source symmetry so f'(m) in L_{P'}(y).

target_claims.R1: y'm is an edge in every P7-free C11 survivor.
target_claims.R2: f'(m) belongs to L(y) minus L(y').
target_claims.R3: f(s) belongs to L(y') minus L(y).
target_claims.R4: Both list differences are singletons, hence L(y)\L(y')={f'(m)} and L(y')\L(y)={f(s)}.
target_claims.R6: Within {y',z,y,s,p,m,n}, n has exactly one neighbor, namely m.

R1: verify all consecutive edges in y'-z-y-s-p-m-n
verify every nonconsecutive pair is already forced nonadjacent by frozen C11 facts except possibly y'm
R2: source orientation gives f'(m) in L(y)
m is in enlarged seed and y'm is an edge
R3: s in T and s not in T' gives ys edge and y's nonedge
f(T) and f(T') are singleton and distinct
therefore no seed neighbor of y' has color f(s), so f(s) is in L(y')
R4: both are 3-subsets of [4], so each directed set difference has size 1
R5: cycle edges: y'z, zy, ys, sp, pm, my'
all possible cycle chords are excluded by frozen facts plus R1
R6: n is nonadjacent to y',y,p by stability
n is nonadjacent to z because z is anticomplete to stored support
n is nonadjacent to s because s is not in T'
